c01.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: late 30s, curly auburn hair, oversized cream cardigan.
c01.content: She stands in front of a wall calendar staring at a circled date, mug frozen halfway to her mouth.

c02.content: She stands at an open closet holding up two dresses, looking at both with quiet dread.

c04.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: late 30s, curly auburn hair, oversized cream cardigan.
c04.content: Close on her phone in her hands: she is typing a message, deleting it, typing again, face conflicted.

c05.content: Product shot from a television pharmaceutical commercial: an amber prescription pill bottle with a clean white label; the label reads CANCELLIA in large letters, and beneath it in smaller letters HOMEBODINE HCL and EXTENDED RELEASE TABLETS 25 mg; the bottle stands on a seamless soft white studio background, bathed in warm golden light, gentle glow, photorealistic.

c06.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: late 30s, curly auburn hair, oversized cream cardigan.
c06.content: She presses send on her phone and exhales enormously, shoulders dropping, eyes closing in relief; warm color blooming into the scene.

c07.content: A deep bubble bath with a paperback book, a lit candle on the tub edge, her curly hair piled up, utterly serene, warm lamplight.

c08.content: She is wrapped in a blanket on a couch with a mug of tea and a cat, golden lamp light, deep evening contentment.

c09.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: late 30s, curly auburn hair, oversized cream cardigan.
c09.content: On the couch she smiles down at her phone at a reply, hand on her chest, touched and relieved.

c10.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: late 30s, curly auburn hair, oversized cream cardigan.
c10.content: Seen from outside through the window at night: her living room glows warm and golden, one lamp lit, a silhouette curled on the couch, gentle and inviting.

c11.content: Minimal end card for a television pharmaceutical commercial: flat solid cream background, the word CANCELLIA in large elegant dark serif capital letters centered, beneath it in smaller letters the tagline: Ask your doctor if staying home is right for you. A small amber pill bottle sits below the text. Clean flat studio typography, no gradients.
